title: Anniversary Cake
body:
This mysterious cake is created by the finest of cake artists! Some could say it's infused with ? ? ?, others would say it's just a delicious treat. Who knows?

This item celebrates Oaklands' Release Anniversary! Thank you for your support. ❤

Anniversary Cake is a limited-time object that can be bought at The Oak Depot for $250. It is a slice of chocolate cake with purple frosting.

Details

The Anniversary Cake was only available for two weeks.

After purchase, the player can press E on the cake to eat it. Eating the cake causes it to disappear and plays a heavily distorted "nom nom nom" sound effect, before gradually turning the player's vision completely purple. This lasts for 15 seconds, after which the effect fades.
